user_steering: Why progress is not turning into a better result; strategy review before another mechanism.
evidence_status: Source/history/saved-receipt critique; no new empirical inference, quality statistic, dataset or checkpoint reads.

issues.impact: Most search explored heads, loss adjustments and small frozen-state additions, not distinct learned temporal representations.
issues.change: Report mechanism families and parent-training GPU time separately; allocate at least one genuinely different high-upside treatment before another head-only micro-variant.

issues.problem: Research spending gates became operational artifact vetoes
issues.impact: Fallback is faster but demonstrably lower on the reconstructed GPU anchor. Q3 is a plausible frontier point, not established superior, and was rejected by a self-imposed usefulness threshold.
issues.change: Preserve old failures. In a new prospectively declared deployment decision compare quality, runtime, portability and uncertainty jointly; do not relabel the old Q3 gate as passed.

issues.problem: Conservative50min target was treated like official60min feasibility
issues.impact: Full4 quantized candidate was not tested end-to-end against official deadline; no evidence says it qualifies, but the soft target prematurely removed it from possible operational frontier.
issues.change: Consider one prospective full-process feasibility decision only if serving hardware/fallback and quantized quality can also be qualified. Thin projected headroom is a risk, not an automatic pass.

issues.problem: Fold sign veto and fixed gain threshold confuse exploration with confirmation
issues.impact: A tiny negative fold estimate is not proof of transfer failure; positive points on both folds are not confirmation. Threshold changes after outcomes would create selection bias.
issues.change: Use prospective cost-aware continuation rules, full paired uncertainty and explicit downside sensitivity; no universal zero-sign veto for exploratory ranking.

issues.problem: Comparator quality and training coupling sometimes answered the wrong question
issues.evidence: ENS members trained against stale partners then both replaced; saved mixed interaction -0.000490928. Scale arm started from parent, not fitted H2.
issues.impact: Joint failure is a real failure of this recipe, not evidence that joint ensemble optimization or scale calibration cannot help.
issues.change: Test a deployment-coherent candidate against the incumbent first; require complex mechanism controls only when that mechanism claim or decision justifies them.

issues.problem: Replicated fresh controls and many secondary readouts consumed attention after reproducibility was established
issues.evidence: SAM and SCALAR fresh ordinary OOFs reproduced existing incumbent bytes; paired/incumbent readouts duplicate one numeric contrast in each family.
issues.impact: Those controls provided real implementation evidence, but should not become mandatory every future branch; fit/WP counts overstate new information.
issues.change: Reuse exact-provenance controls for unchanged numerical recipes; use one source/synthetic parity audit and retrain a control only when matching differences matter.

issues.problem: Negative history and proxy tests were generalized too far
issues.evidence: E103 measured selector AUC gain .0022 under .005 gate; E170 sharper qX weights and E186 coarse residual map are different tests.22memberensemble ceiling applies only to those families.
issues.impact: Neither a selector AUC null nor correlated-family ensemble saturation establishes conditional-selection irrelevance or irreducible noise.
issues.change: Record exact falsified recipe and proxy-validity limits; no automatic rerun, but novelty is not a competition requirement.

issues.problem: Exposed folds and uncertain test mixture limit small local gains
issues.evidence: Historical local ensemble around.702 versus public.6641 are different domains; journal reports train/valid shift,class3/chain-length differences and nonmonotonic validation-repeat public results.
issues.impact: More micro-search on the same two exposed folds may improve local selection without improving hidden test.
issues.change: Use a small prospectively fixed set of relevant regime/chain-length sensitivity views based on saved sufficient statistics; never call these fresh holdouts or tune mixture to public anecdotes.

issues.problem: Exactness audits and shipping work grew beyond marginal decision value
issues.evidence: Multiple source freezes, wrapper/checker revisions, native builds and long full traces; several found real bugs, while others were duplicative. No complete audit-time accounting exists.
issues.impact: Integrity was valuable, but serial proofs for candidates lacking target-relevance evidence delayed learning.
issues.change: One shared validator, one cheap stream/gradient check before training, native port only for a promising recipe; one long final audit for finalist. Preserve essential leak/evaluator/resource checks.

issues.problem: State-refresh is another uncalibrated proxy, not the default next high-upside experiment

evidence.proxy: output RMS relative to post-update full-prefix model

issues.impact: Large mismatch does not imply forecast error; small early mismatch cannot refute later phases. Four reset probes are structurally easier; AMP skips confound observed update effects.
issues.change: Pause priority; if revisited, declare narrow phase-specific diagnostic, nonreset probes, no automatic16fit escalation and bounded-memory resource policy.

hard_requirements: No leakage or hidden-label/mask serving inputs; correct global metric and legal data provenance.
Finite causal/reset-consistent deterministic serving; official1CPU/16GB/60min/20MB and compatible CPU path.
Do not mutate preserved evidence, stop unrelated jobs, push GitHub or submit publicly without authorization.
soft_priorities_not_rules: both exposed fold point estimates nonnegative
fresh ordinary control in every branch
exact bit agreement across unrelated numerical backends
next_round_order: First produce a single honest quality/runtime/ISA frontier using existing evidence; select one unresolved operational question with measurable decision value.
Before new parent fitting, state what residual error or untested capacity the treatment addresses and why it differs from exact historical failures.
At most one promising full-recipe treatment screen: two folds, one paired seed, parent+H2 per fold (four treatment fits), reuse eligible frozen incumbent controls.

Use one primary comparison against the strong incumbent ensemble in the intended role (addition/replacement), with serving constraints reported separately. Weakened fixed3 may be an operational reference, not the sole scientific baseline. Avoid duplicate paired/incumbent queries.
If economically credible but uncertain, allocate a second paired seed or a better transfer check; if null, retain result and choose a different family. No invented significance/first-place guarantee.
Separate artifact selection from recipe confirmation: an exposed-fold operational choice remains exploratory, while evidence requirements for replicated recipe claims remain higher.

initial_2h_planning_only.alternative_not_parallel_sprawl: Choose serving-frontier qualification OR one genuinely distinct treatment screen first; do not launch three expensive lines simply because three agents exist.
initial_2h_planning_only.status: Illustrative planning envelope only; user duration/allocation not established and these minute values are not requirements.

allocation_policy.stop_condition: Stop a branch at its prospectively stated decision rule; stop an entire round when its declared time/resource budget expires and report strongest evidence honestly. Until a result is not permission for unbounded compute or invented superiority.
allocation_policy.resource_recommendations_not_universal_r: For workloads like the failed prefetch probe, use bounded streaming and preventive allocator limits; retain truthful distinction from whole-device memory enforcement. Apply controls proportionate to the allocated workload, not all prior infrastructure to every plan.

resource_lessons.status: Recommendations for a future workload like the failed prefetch probe, not universal hard requirements; no pilot allocated.
resource_lessons.preventive_limit: Set native PyTorch caching-allocator fraction before large CUDA allocations using an explicit byte cap, provisionally4096MiB with1536MiB headroom beneath5632MiB total policy; derive fraction from actual visible capacity. OOM stops, no automatic batch/cap retry.
resource_lessons.limitation: Allocator bound is not a hard NVML/device total-memory partition; CUDA context and other allocations may be outside it. If absolute total enforcement is required, obtain a real partition/enforcer or do not claim that guarantee.
bounded_pipeline: One bounded CPU batch at a time, explicit max-prefetch depth, preferably no side-stream prefetch in the initial diagnostic.
At most one GPU batch and one chunk activation graph; sequential no_grad replays, retain scalar summaries not GPU outputs.
Synchronize at declared probe/batch boundaries; release all references before next batch; no queued checksum copies of whole batches.
Validate the exact shape/forward/backward/probe combination on generated tensors under allocator cap before any real-data run.
Actual cgroup memory/swap/CPU controls, owned PID/start-tick group termination, external wall cap and NVML total/own telemetry remain secondary containment.
resource_lessons.comparability: Disabling async prefetch is a resource design change; keep it identical across comparison arms and do not claim old-loader bit/runtime parity without evidence.

candidate_direction_under_separate_asses: Wide shallow recurrent student with current since/EMA inputs, causal d256 teachers and ordinary H2. Direction only, not approved recipe/allocation or predicted gain.
